{{Quote|There is a den of Selonians just outside Nashal.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Talus}}</ref>}}
A '''cave''' located on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] was inhabited by the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] of the [[Neetha Den]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Askura deal was proposed by a den mate that precipitated the smugglers' exploitation of our den. It allowed a group of our mates to be taken prisoner and held as hostages to get us to mine for the smugglers.|The [[Kiisa Kimotte|Neetha den mother]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AtDM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Address the Den Mother|Talus}}</ref>}}
The cave was located near the city of [[Nashal]], on the planet Talus of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. During the Galactic Civil War, it was inhabited by the Selonians of the Neetha Den,<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> including the [[Kiisa Kimotte|Neetha den mother]],<ref name="SWG:AtDM" /> the [[sept]] [[Kiki Dorente]], advisor to the den mother,<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> [[Tika Sileste]],<ref name="SWG:EaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Exploiting a Weakness|Talus}}</ref> [[Ravi Thienta]],<ref name="SWG:UYT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Under Your Thumb|Talus}}</ref> and [[Lika Fimente]].<ref name="SWG:GtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Gather the Missing|Talus}}</ref>

The cave was located near the [[Smuggler Base|base]] of the [[Talusian Smugglers]].<ref name="SWG:FaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Finding a Weakness|Talus}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several Selonians of the Neetha Den were captured by the smugglers and kept as hostages in order to force the rest of the den into mining for them.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> Smuggler guards also occupied the cave in order to watch for the Selonians.<ref name="SWG:FaW" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] was aware of the situation but was unable to intervene in Selonians matters. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] thus recruited an independent spacer in order to help the Seloninans without involving the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> The spacer therefore assaulted the smuggler base. Although the spacer eventually discovered that the captive Selonians had already been sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]],<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> the raid severely weakened the smugglers and crippled their ability to exploit the Selonians.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /><ref name="SWG:AtDM" /><ref name="SWG:EaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cave of the Neetha Den appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The cave was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
